newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner confirms death of Chairman Levin's son.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner confirms death of Chairman Levin's son.

text.p: Time Warner Inc. on Tuesday confirmed the death of Chairman Gerald Levin's son, Jonathan, whom police say may have been murdered.
In a press statement issued by Time Warner, President Richard Parsons said, "We are shocked and saddened by the death of Jonathan Levin."
According to local news reports, police found the body of Levin, 34, at about 10:30 p.m. EDT on Monday at his apartment in the Upper West Side of Manhattan.

He had been bound and gagged and his body was severely decomposed, according to the reports. There were, however, no visible stab or gunshot wounds. Another teacher who lived in the same building and had a key to Levin's apartment found the body Monday and called police.
Levin, a teacher at Taft High School in the Bronx, did not show up for work Friday or Monday, according to the news reports and police, who were investigating the death.

"The sympathy, love and prayers of all the women and men of Time Warner go out to Jerry, Barbara and Carol Levin, and the entire Levin family," Parsons said. "This is a time of profound grief for them. It is our sincere hope they will be accorded the privacy needed to mourn this devastating loss and to begin the process of healing."
